sources.name: PRH — Finnish Trade Register (Kaupparekisteri)
sources.verdict: National commercial register operated by the Finnish Patent and Registration Office. Authoritative company register; machine route is the separate open-data API (next entry). Site is server-rendered; this exact path not fetch-verified this run but PRH domain confirmed live via avoindata.prh.fi.

sources.name: PRH/YTJ Open Data API (avoindata.prh.fi)
sources.category: commercial register open data / bulk API
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Genuinely open, no-auth REST APIs: (1) YTJ company data API (trade register basics + tax-admin registrations), (2) registered trade-register notifications API (filings since 2014-11-07), (3) digital financial statements API (iXBRL income statement/balance sheet). Attribution required. This is the primary $0 deterministic entity backbone for FI.

sources.name: YTJ — Business Information System (BIS)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Joint PRH/Tax Administration company search by name, Business ID or LEI; links filings and beneficial-owner obligations. Human search UI; use the open data API for machine access.

sources.name: PRH Virre Information Service
sources.category: trade register extracts, financial statements, foundation register
sources.verdict: Exists but our fetcher hit a redirect loop (session-based Java webapp). Paid extracts + free searches of trade register and Register of Foundations. Use avoindata.prh.fi for machine access; Virre for documents.

sources.name: PRH Register of Foundations (Säätiörekisteri)
sources.verdict: PRH-operated foundation register (Finnish foundations are significant LP allocators). Data accessed via Virre. URL not fetch-verified this run; PRH is the confirmed operator.

sources.name: Avoindata.fi — national open data portal (CKAN)
sources.verdict: Real national CKAN portal with API at /data/api/3/action/*, but returned HTTP 403 to our fetcher (bot protection on cloud UAs). Hosts datasets incl. the bankruptcy/restructuring register data. Retry from production crawler with proper UA.

sources.name: FIN-FSA — List of supervised entities
sources.category: regulator register: banks, fund ManCos, AIFMs, investment firms
sources.verdict: VERIFIED page. Register of all FIN-FSA-supervised entities (incl. AIFMs, UCITS ManCos and their funds, investment firms), updated nightly; front-end register app is backed by a JSON endpoint (already harvested in this project — extend that harvest rather than re-derive).

sources.name: FIN-FSA — Registers hub (notifications, tied agents, insurance intermediaries, prospectuses)
sources.category: regulator registers: passporting notifications, insurance intermediaries, prospectuses
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Hub for: prospectus register, notification lists (EEA passported service providers), tied agents, insurance intermediary register (separate external DB), equity savings account providers, warning lists. No documented API; per-register scraping needed.

sources.name: FIN-FSA — Virtual currency / MiCA service providers
sources.verdict: MiCA authorizations and legacy virtual currency provider registrations are held by FIN-FSA and surface through its supervised-entities/notification lists (verified hub above); no standalone MiCA register page fetch-verified this run. Tokenized-RWA (category 5) sourcing route.

sources.name: Bank of Finland / FIN-FSA Open Data API portal
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Azure API Management developer portal for Suomen Pankki / FIN-FSA open data APIs; free signup for API keys. Covers statistical datasets (rates, MFI, funds). Machine route for BoF data.

sources.name: Bank of Finland — Statistics (investment & private equity funds, MFI)
sources.category: central bank: fund statistics, MFI lists, PE fund aggregates
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Dedicated 'Investment and private equity funds' statistics, MFI balance sheets/interest rates, with an Open Data Service linked. Aggregate market-sizing + reporter population context, not entity-level granularity.

sources.name: Finnish Centre for Pensions (ETK)
sources.category: pension system central body — LP side
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Statutory central body for earnings-related pensions; statistical database, key figures, and taxonomy of pension insurance companies / industry-wide and company pension funds (the Finnish LP universe).

sources.name: Finnish Tax Administration (Vero) — open data
sources.verdict: Vero publishes annual open-data files incl. corporate income tax data (public in Finland). Exact path not fetch-verified this run — verify before wiring; well-established public program.

sources.name: Energy Authority (Energiavirasto) — EU ETS national administrator
sources.verdict: Domain returned HTTP 403 to our fetcher (bot protection); Energiavirasto is the confirmed Finnish national administrator of the Union Registry (EU ETS accounts). Carbon-alt (category 5) sourcing route; EUTL at EU level complements it.

sources.name: Virallinen lehti — Official Gazette of Finland
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Official gazette with electronic edition (Sähköinen lehti); publishes statutory announcements. Submitting requires login; reading the e-journal does not. Scrape-ability of archive needs a follow-up pass.

sources.name: Insolvency Register (Maksukyvyttömyysrekisteri, Legal Register Centre)
sources.verdict: URL live (VERIFIED reachable) but renders as a JS SPA with no static content for our fetcher. Free public search of bankruptcy, restructuring and debt-adjustment cases, run by Oikeusrekisterikeskus. Pair with the open-data dataset below for bulk.

sources.name: Bankruptcy & restructuring register open data (via Avoindata.fi)
sources.verdict: Portal returned 403 to our fetcher (bot protection), so dataset page unverified this run — but this is the hinted konkurssit open-data route from Oikeusrekisterikeskus. Verify slug via CKAN API from production crawler. Distressed/NPL (category 2) signal gold.

sources.name: Finlex — legal information databank
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Free Ministry of Justice databank: statutes, decades of court decisions (Supreme, appeal, administrative, Market Court), government proposals, treaties; has an open data section. Context/monitoring source, not an entity register.

sources.name: Konkurssiasiamies — Bankruptcy Ombudsman
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Independent authority supervising bankruptcy estate administration; publishes recommendations, statements, statistics; runs the Kosti case system. Best national proxy for the insolvency-practitioner ecosystem (Finland has no separate IP roll — see searchedButAbsent).

sources.name: Nasdaq Helsinki — listed companies & First North Growth Market
sources.verdict: Legacy nasdaqomxnordic.com listed-companies page now 301s to nasdaq.com European market activity, which is JS-driven and reset our connection. Issuer universe still fully recoverable via disclosure wires (GlobeNewswire/STT) and FIN-FSA prospectus register; expect an undocumented JSON behind the screener.

sources.name: GlobeNewswire — Nasdaq Helsinki (OMXH) company disclosures
sources.verdict: Page loads (VERIFIED reachable) but our fetch showed 'no articles for this search' — the exchange filter syntax needs confirmation. GlobeNewswire is Nasdaq's wire and does carry Helsinki company releases; it also offers per-search RSS. Needs one interactive session to pin the right filter/feed URL.

sources.name: Pääomasijoittajat (FVCA) — member directory
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Finnish Venture Capital Association, ~200 members incl. VC/PE funds, fund investors, family offices, corporate VCs — largest in Nordics. Already harvested per task hint; keep for refresh. Also publishes FVCA industry statistics.

sources.name: FiBAN — Finnish Business Angels Network
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. 630 angels, annual investment reports and per-year angel-investment statistics (EUR 526m tracked since 2011). Entity leads (angel-backed startups, syndicates) + market stats.

sources.name: Finance Finland (Finanssiala ry) — members
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (hub page; members page linked from nav). Represents banks, life/non-life insurers, pension companies, finance houses (leasing/factoring), fund ManCos, securities dealers — one association covering what several countries split across many.

sources.name: TELA — Finnish Pension Alliance (member organisations)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Association of all statutory earnings-related pension insurers (the core Finnish LP base, ~EUR 250bn+ AUM); member list is behind an About-us subpage not directly displayed on the homepage. TELA also publishes quarterly investment-allocation analyses of pension assets.

sources.name: Keva — public sector pension provider
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Public-sector pension provider; publishes investment section, annual/interim reports with allocation detail (incl. alternatives). Key LP profile source.

sources.name: Business Finland
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. State innovation-funding and trade/investment-promotion agency; news page is server-rendered and parseable (no RSS visible). Grant/funding decisions signal early-stage pipeline.

sources.name: Finnvera
sources.verdict: VERIFIED at /eng. Loans, guarantees, export credit guarantees; publishes financing statistics and press releases. Private-debt-adjacent (category 2) state actor.

sources.name: Tesi (Finnish Industry Investment)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. State-owned investor listing BOTH portfolio funds (GP discovery: e.g. Cloudberry VC, Evolver Equity) and direct portfolio companies. High-value seed list for FI GP universe and LP-commitment edges.

sources.name: Sitra — Finnish Innovation Fund
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Public endowment-like fund under Parliament; publishes research and holds investments (incl. fund positions reported in annual report). Secondary entity source, primary for context.

sources.name: Finnfund
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Finnish DFI, EUR 857m portfolio, lists current investments by sector (forestry, renewables, financial institutions, agriculture, digital infra). Real-assets/impact (categories 3, 5) edges.

sources.name: Solidium
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Lists all twelve listed-equity holdings with exact ownership percentages (~EUR 9.8bn, Aug 2026): Nokia 5.7%, Konecranes 11.1%, Outokumpu 15.0%, etc. Clean ownership-edge source.

sources.name: Government ownership steering (Prime Minister's Office)
sources.verdict: valtioneuvosto.fi returned 403 to our fetcher (bot protection); the ownership-steering department and its annual report listing all state shareholdings are real and public. Retry from production crawler.

sources.name: Hilma — public procurement notices (hankintailmoitukset.fi)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED reachable but renders as a JS SPA. Hilma has a documented open API for procurement notices (Azure API Management based); infra/real-asset concession and advisory-mandate signals. Locate API docs via site 'avoin rajapinta' section from a browser session.

sources.name: Finnish Bar Association + Find-a-Lawyer directory
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via asianajajat.fi (asianajajaliitto.fi 301s there). Official find-a-lawyer app lists all licensed advocates/firms, filterable by specialty (M&A, insolvency, funds). Category 6 sourcing. Respect the no-individual-harvesting rule: firm-level only.

sources.name: Finland Chamber of Commerce (Keskuskauppakamari) — authorized property valuers (AKA)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED site; it runs the property-valuation authorization (AKA/KHK) system, though the valuer register itself wasn't visible on the EN homepage — locate the 'Auktorisoidut kiinteistöarvioijat' search subpage. Finland's substitute for a deep RICS bench (category 3 service graph).

sources.name: RAKLI — real estate owners & construction clients association
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Association of professional property owners, investors and developers; member organisations under 'Jäsenorganisaatiot' subpage. Category 3 entity discovery (RE investors, developers, managers).

sources.name: KTI Property Information
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. KTI Index, quarterly transactions service, property-development tracking, special investment (RE) funds reviews, annual 'The Finnish Property Market' report (free PDF). Deep data is subscription (KTI Online) — use free reports only.

sources.name: Statistics Finland — StatFin PxWeb API
sources.category: official statistics API (bankruptcies, national accounts, RE prices)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED — API returned the database node list (JSON). Free PxWeb API covering bankruptcies, financial accounts, housing/RE prices, enterprise demographics. Context and macro layers at $0.

sources.name: Kauppalehti
sources.verdict: Finland's main business daily. Both site and feeds.kauppalehti.fi refused our fetcher; Alma Media has curtailed public RSS, so the legacy feed URL is recorded UNVERIFIED. Headline+link only, paywalled body — respect copyright discipline.

sources.name: Talouselämä
sources.verdict: Leading business magazine (deals, ownership, funds). Fetch refused (Alma bot-block); no public RSS confirmed. Monitor via front-page crawl from production infra or via STT/Epressi releases it covers.

sources.verdict: Investor-focused markets title under Alma; not fetch-verified this run (same Alma bot-wall expected). Listed for completeness of the markets-media set; verify from production crawler.

sources.name: Tekniikka & Talous
sources.verdict: Tech/industry title relevant to industrials, energy and infra deal signals. Not fetch-verified this run; same Alma access caveats.

sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Freemium equity-research platform covering Nasdaq Helsinki: free daily morning reviews, analyst comments, events calendar; premium locks full reports. No RSS found (guessed /fi/rss returned 404). Never reproduce research bodies — headline/metadata signals only.

sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Year-organized supervision releases (2013–2026), press and news releases, reporting releases, quarterly market newsletter. No RSS found (guessed /en/rss-feeds/ 404). Enforcement/authorization signals — license grants and withdrawals are entity-lifecycle events.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Strong on Finnish GP/LP fund-level data: FVCA-member buyout/VC funds, pension LPs (Keva, Varma, Ilmarinen) commitment tracking, fundraising and performance. Thin on Finnish service graph, NPL/distressed, and anything below institutional fund size.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: FIN-FSA AIFM/ManCo authorizations, Pääomasijoittajat (FVCA) member and statistics publications, pension providers' own annual/interim reports (Keva, TELA members), press releases — all directly reachable via the FIN-FSA supervised-entities register, paaomasijoittajat.fi, tela.fi/keva.fi listed above.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Good Finnish deal coverage (M&A, PE buyouts, VC rounds) and company financials; weaker on LP granularity and local insolvency/credit events.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: PRH trade register + financial statements (the avoindata.prh.fi iXBRL API is the direct route), Nasdaq Helsinki disclosures via GlobeNewswire/STT, press wires, FVCA statistics.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Best-in-class Finnish startup/VC ecosystem mapping (works with Nordic ecosystem orgs); rounds, valuations, investor graphs. Not focused on debt, real assets, or service graph.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: PRH/YTJ open data for entity backbone, Business Finland and FiBAN announcements/statistics, ArcticStartup and Yle/HS press coverage, Tesi portfolio disclosures — all cataloged above as direct sources.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Broad but shallow Finnish startup coverage; self-reported profiles plus press-derived rounds. Frequent gaps and stale data outside VC.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Press releases (STT Info/Epressi wires), company self-reporting, news coverage — nothing they use that we cannot reach via the wires and Yle/HS feeds directly.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: The dominant local company & credit information provider: credit ratings, payment defaults, financials, real-estate/condo data, ESG scores. Covers ALL Finnish companies — the credit/distress layer global platforms lack. Commercial product; do not scrape.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: PRH trade register + financial statements, Legal Register Centre insolvency register, enforcement (ulosotto) data, Vero tax data, court payment-default records — the public originals are avoindata.prh.fi, maksukyvyttomyysrekisteri.om.fi and Vero open data, all cataloged above.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Nordic sales-intelligence over 5M+ companies (FI/SE/DK/NO): firmographics, financials, group structures, technographics, change signals. Strong entity backbone, no alternatives-specific intelligence.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: States 'official sources' + financial statements — in practice PRH/YTJ open data and filed financials (avoindata.prh.fi APIs), plus company websites. We reach the same registries directly at $0.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Kauppalehti-branded company information, financials, decision-maker data and TE-500 style rankings; deeply integrated with Alma's business media. Commercial; do not scrape.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: PRH trade register, filed financial statements, official announcements (gazette/insolvency) — same public originals we ingest via avoindata.prh.fi and the insolvency open data.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Community equity research covering nearly the whole Nasdaq Helsinki main list + First North: estimates, recommendations, insider-trade tracking. Listed-equity only, not private alternatives — but the best public window on Finnish listed RE funds/REIT-likes.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Nasdaq Helsinki company disclosures (GlobeNewswire/STT wires), company IR pages, FIN-FSA prospectus register — all direct-access sources in our catalog.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: The authority on Finnish institutional real estate: transaction volumes, rental indices, special investment fund (open-ended RE fund) reviews. Subscription product with meaningful free annual reports.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Own proprietary surveys (not replicable), plus public deal press releases and FIN-FSA special-investment-fund registrations — the public slice is reachable via FIN-FSA registers and the release wires.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Free-tier company lookup (financials snapshots, Business IDs, officers) used widely by Finnish professionals; consumer-grade, no alternatives angle.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: PRH/YTJ open data and filed financials — identical originals to avoindata.prh.fi.

searchedButAbsent: Session web-search budget was exhausted at task start (200/200 used), so discovery ran on domain knowledge + direct URL verification (30+ fetches); items below are stated with that caveat. (1) No standalone Finnish insolvency-practitioner roll: bankruptcy administrators are court-appointed attorneys supervised by Konkurssiasiamies — the Bar Association directory + Konkurssiasiamies are the substitutes. (2) No separate fund-administrator license category: administration falls under FIN-FSA investment-services/AIFM authorizations. (3) No standalone national MiCA register page verified: MiCA licensees surface inside FIN-FSA's supervised-entities/notification lists. (4) RICS has minimal Finland presence: the national valuer credential is Keskuskauppakamari's AKA/KHK authorization, not RICS. (5) Good News from Finland is discontinued as a standalone outlet (301s into businessfinland.com marketing) — dropped rather than padded. (6) Alma Media (Kauppalehti/Talouselämä/Arvopaperi) has withdrawn public RSS and hard-blocks cloud fetchers; legacy feed URLs recorded as unverified. (7) Nasdaq's legacy nordic listed-companies page (nasdaqomxnordic.com) is retired — issuer lists now only via JS-heavy nasdaq.com or disclosure wires. (8) No Finnish privatization agency exists (no active privatization program); state-asset routes are Solidium + PMO ownership steering. (9) No dedicated Finnish litigation-funding or royalties registry found — category 5 sourcing must come via press wires and PRH classification. (10) avoindata.fi and valtioneuvosto.fi/energiavirasto.fi 403-block cloud user agents — real sources, need production-crawler UA, flagged honestly in verdicts.
